# Oxford Learner's Dictionaries

> > Comprehensive English dictionary resource providing definitions, pronunciations, usage notes, and examples for learners of English at all levels.

Oxford Learner's Dictionaries offers authoritative lexicographic content from Oxford University Press, featuring the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary, Oxford Advanced American Dictionary, and Oxford Collocations Dictionary. The platform includes detailed word entries with etymology, pronunciation guides, illustrated vocabulary lists, and practical usage examples drawn from the Oxford English Corpus.

## Key Topics

- English vocabulary
- Dictionary definitions
- Pronunciation guides
- Word etymology
- Usage notes
- Collocations
- British and American English
- Formal vocabulary
- Parts of speech (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs)
- Latin and Greek word origins
- English language learning
- Academic vocabulary
- Illustrated word lists

## Dictionary Entries: Core Vocabulary

- [abusive adjective](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abusive): Definition, pronunciation, and usage examples for 'abusive' with behavioral and linguistic contexts
- [acceleration noun](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/acceleration): Physical and metaphorical meanings of 'acceleration' with technical and everyday usage
- [acclaim verb](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/acclaim_1): Definition with example from Mario Vargas Llosa, showing usage in critical and public recognition contexts
- [accustomed adjective](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accustomed): Usage patterns for 'accustomed' with common collocations and grammatical notes
- [accreditation noun](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accreditation): Academic and professional certification terminology with institutional usage examples
- [aborigine noun](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/aborigine): Definition with cultural sensitivity notes and Australian indigenous terminology

## Dictionary Entries: Academic & Formal Vocabulary

- [abjure verb](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abjure): Formal verb with Latin etymology, used in legal and philosophical contexts
- [abstruse adjective](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abstruse): Advanced vocabulary item describing complex or difficult-to-understand concepts, with Latin roots
- [abhorrence noun](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abhorrence): Formal noun expressing strong dislike or hatred, with literary usage patterns
- [academically adverb](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/academically): Educational context adverb with usage in scholarly and institutional settings
- [abstainer noun](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abstainer): Person who refrains from something, typically alcohol, with collocation patterns
- [abysmally adverb](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abysmally): Intensifying adverb indicating extremely poor quality or performance

## Dictionary Entries: Technical & Specialized Terms

- [acoustically adverb](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/acoustically): Technical adverb relating to sound properties and acoustic engineering
- [absolute magnitude noun](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absolute-magnitude): Astronomy term defining the intrinsic brightness of celestial objects
- [abutment noun](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abutment): Civil engineering and architecture term for bridge support structures
- [abacus noun](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abacus): Ancient calculating device with Latin and Greek etymology and historical context
- [accessorize verb](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accessorize): Fashion terminology with British and American spelling variants

## Dictionary Entries: Proper Nouns & Abbreviations

- [Dean Acheson](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/dean-acheson): Biographical entry for US Secretary of State under Harry S. Truman, architect of the Marshall Plan and NATO
- [ABTA abbreviation](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abta): Association of British Travel Agents, UK travel industry regulatory organization

## Learning Resources & Features

- [About Pictures word list](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/pictures.html): Guide to illustrated vocabulary lists with visual learning aids for thematic word groups
